gloss: likeness (of a face); portrait; facial resemblance

definitions.gloss: likeness (of a face); portrait; facial resemblance
definitions.explanation: Most commonly encountered in the compound 似顔絵 (caricature/portrait sketch).

examples.japanese: ⟦{似顔絵|にがおえ}→似顔絵：11456_nigaoe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|か}いて→描く：28436_kaku⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I had a portrait sketch drawn of me.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{似顔絵|にがおえ}{師|し}→似顔絵師：29328_nigaoeshi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{絵|え}→絵：02613_e⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|か}いている→描く：28436_kaku⟧。
examples.english: A portrait artist is drawing pictures in front of the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{似顔絵|にがおえ}→似顔絵：11456_nigaoe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{公開|こうかい}→公開：11665_koukai⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A composite sketch of the suspect was released.

notes:
Combines ⟦{似|に}→似る：01159_niru⟧ (resemblance) and {顔|がお} (face). Almost always appears in the compound ⟦{似顔絵|にがおえ}→似顔絵：11456_nigaoe⟧ (portrait sketch/caricature). ⟦{似顔絵|にがおえ}→似顔絵：11456_nigaoe⟧ can refer to both artistic portrait sketches drawn at tourist spots and festivals, and police composite sketches of suspects.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{似顔絵|にがおえ}→似顔絵：11456_nigaoe⟧: portrait sketch, caricature
- ⟦{似顔絵|にがおえ}{師|し}→似顔絵師：29328_nigaoeshi⟧: portrait artist
- ⟦{似顔絵|にがおえ}→似顔絵：11456_nigaoe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|か}く→描く：28436_kaku⟧: to draw a portrait sketch
- ⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{似顔絵|にがおえ}→似顔絵：11456_nigaoe⟧: composite sketch of a suspect

CULTURAL NOTE:
⟦{似顔絵|にがおえ}→似顔絵：11456_nigaoe⟧ artists are a common sight at Japanese tourist spots, festivals, and amusement parks. The style often leans toward caricature, exaggerating distinctive facial features.
